meta.name: Analyze pharma label change impact with Anthropic Claude and Slack

parameters.content:
## Pharma Label Change Impact Analyzer

### How it works

This workflow periodically or manually checks a pharmaceutical product label source, compares the current label text with the last known baseline, and stops if no change is detected. When a change is found, it enriches the diff with product master data, uses an AI model to assess regulatory and quality impact, then routes the case based on severity for review, sign-off, updates, logging, and notifications. Approved or review-level changes update the product master record, create a compliance log entry, notify the relevant teams, and persist the new label as the baseline for future runs.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger frequency and use the manual trigger for test runs.
- Set the productId, productName, labelSourceUrl, productMasterApiUrl, and complianceLogApiUrl values in the configuration node.
- Add credentials for the label source and product master/compliance APIs if those endpoints require authentication.
- Configure the Anthropic credential/model used by the AI Agent for label impact analysis.
- Connect Slack credentials and set the channels or users for regulatory, quality, review, and rejection alerts.
- Configure the email sending credentials and recipient list for the regulatory and quality summary.
- Ensure the code nodes that read and update the last known label store are connected to the intended persistence location, such as static data, a database, or external storage.

### Customization

Adjust the diff logic, AI prompt/model, severity routing rules, sign-off wait behavior, and notification templates to match internal regulatory and quality procedures.

## Start and configure run

Provides scheduled and manual entry points, then initializes product and endpoint configuration used by the rest of the workflow.

## Detect label changes

Fetches the latest label text, compares it against the stored baseline, and decides whether the workflow should continue into impact analysis.

## End unchanged cycle

Terminates the run when the label comparison shows no meaningful change.

## Prepare product context

Retrieves product master data and merges it with the detected label diff so downstream analysis has the required product context.

## Analyze change impact

Runs the label diff and product context through an AI agent backed by an Anthropic chat model, then parses the analysis into structured fields for routing.

## Route for review

Branches the case by severity, sending review-level changes to Slack or holding higher-risk changes for regulatory and quality sign-off.

## Handle sign-off outcome

Evaluates the sign-off result; rejected cases are marked accordingly and a rejection alert is sent, while approved cases continue toward product master updates.

## Update compliance records

Applies accepted label changes to the product master system and records the change in the compliance log.

## Notify teams and persist

Sends regulatory, quality, and email summaries after logging, then updates the last known label baseline for the next polling cycle.
